libraryRootNoteId.label: Library Root
libraryRootNoteId.description: Required. Parent note every movie/show note is created under. Create a note for your library, then pick it here.

defaultStatus.label: Status For New Titles
defaultStatus.description: Applied to a title added by hand from search. Imports set status from the source instead.

posterSize.label: Poster Size
posterSize.description: TMDB image width used for poster URLs stored on each title note.

tmdbApiKey.label: TMDB API Key
tmdbApiKey.description: Free v3 API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Required for search, posters, and episode lists.

traktClientId.label: Trakt Client ID
traktClientId.description: Create an API app at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications. Use urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob as the redirect URI.

traktClientSecret.label: Trakt Client Secret
traktClientSecret.description: Client secret from the same Trakt API app.

traktAccessToken.label: Access Token
traktAccessToken.description: Filled in automatically after you authorize. Clear it to force re-authorization.

traktRefreshToken.label: Refresh Token
traktRefreshToken.description: Filled in automatically. Used to renew the access token without re-authorizing.

stremioEmail.label: Stremio Email
stremioEmail.description: Login email for your Stremio account.

stremioPassword.label: Stremio Password
stremioPassword.description: Only used to obtain an auth key. Cleared automatically once login succeeds.

stremioAuthKey.label: Stremio Auth Key
stremioAuthKey.description: Filled in automatically after a successful login. Clear it to force re-login.

importMarksWatched.label: Imports Set Watched Status
importMarksWatched.description: An imported title with watch history is marked watched (movies) or watching (shows with unwatched episodes).

importFetchMetadata.label: Fetch TMDB Metadata On Import
importFetchMetadata.description: Look up each newly imported title on TMDB for poster, overview, runtime, and genres. Slower, and needs a TMDB key.

importOverwriteRatings.label: Let Imports Overwrite My Ratings
importOverwriteRatings.description: Off by default so a re-import never clobbers a rating you set in Trilium. Import is one-way; nothing is ever written back to Trakt or Stremio.
